fieldValues.title: RFC-013: Required Root Container & Structural Navigation
fieldValues.author: Peter Brownell
fieldValues.affected_components:
`manifest.container` required; `Container.identityInstanceId`; structural navigation from membership + `precedes`.

fieldValues.content: Makes `manifest.container` required, adds a reassignable identity pointer `Container.identityInstanceId` to both Container schemas, and defines a structural navigation model derived from existing primitives (container membership + `precedes` order). Full text: rfcs/rfc-013-required-root-container.md. Rev 7 (srs#446): [R9] tightened — a duplicate manifest.container/container-set containerId is fatal under RFC-038 [R12], no precedence; [R5] confirmed as holding without exception now that RFC-009 no longer relies on rootInstanceIds[0] position.
